item.description: Good morning, Sydney! It’s Saturday, May 2nd, 2026, and a beautiful autumn day is shaping up as we welcome you to the Daily Drive. The sun's shining, temperatures are perfect for getting out and about, and with no major events today, it's a fantastic opportunity to unwind or catch up with loved ones. Did you know that today marks the anniversary of Leonardo da Vinci's death in 1519? So, let's channel a little creative genius into our weekend – have a brilliant day, everyone!
